hooks.name: pbt-guard
hooks.description: Before any shell command containing `git commit`, runs `vitest run tests/pbt` in each app whose pure core or PBT inputs changed (cores, tests/pbt, test vectors, Forge schema/input/output and generated spec, MCP env code; full list in scripts/hooks/pbt-guard.mjs). Exit 2 blocks the commit. Fails closed if tests cannot run. Mirrored by .githooks/pre-commit for commits made outside Kiro.
